summary: Completed backend regression and targeted desktop/mobile UI testing for the requested Custodian updates. All live API checks and final browser journeys passed, including updated Food/Ritual content, guest booking count, Mystery Craft reveal gating, locked Time Capsule, dashboard toggles, mobile navigation, overflow, and console checks.
action_items: Consider adding visible error states and catch handlers for experience/profile API requests instead of leaving users on an indefinite loading message.
critical_code_review_comments: Detail, custodian, and Mystery Local data fetches do not expose request failures; a backend/network error can leave the route permanently showing its loading state.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created; six illustrative in-memory experiences were used. Booking confirmation/payment, Mystery confirmation/reveal, and legacy submission remain MOCKED by design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Requested Food, Ritual, story, guest stepper/booking, Mystery Craft delayed reveal, first-visit locked Time Capsule, dashboard, mobile navigation, overflow, image loading, and console checks are covered and passing. The stored API assertion was updated to the new Food title.
rca of the issue: The only initial regression failure was a stale test expectation for the pre-update Food title (the API correctly returned the new banana-leaf meal title). Updating the assertion restored 7/7 backend passes. A first browser run reported a transient Mystery Craft assertion/navigation race; an isolated rerun confirmed hidden pre-reveal state and correct Hands in coir post-reveal behavior.
